To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
hybrid architectures consisting of RBF networks and decision trees are robust and can be used to perform large scale face identification and retrieval tasks.

( i ) hybrid architectures can be successfully applied in the domain of face recognition, and ( ii) the use of contextual cues in conjunction with hybrid classifiers can improve significantly the performance of a retrieval system.

( i ) hybrid classifier systems consisting of an ensemble of RBF networks and DTs can be used for the automatic classification of large data bases consisting facial images; ( ii ) the architecture enjoys robustness due to consensus provided by the ensembles of R.B.F. networks, and categorical classification using DTs; ( iii ) the architecture enjoys flexibility due to the ability of the ensembles of networks to learn new classes, and the ability of DTs to accommodate contextual cues.

the development of robust hybrid architectures for pattern recognition, and the application of such architectures in the area of image understanding.
